data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

data_tooling.name: awesome-generative-ai-guide
data_tooling.summary: 这是一个为生成式AI学习者打造的全方位资源指南，涵盖从最新研究动态到面试准备的核心内容。项目将大语言模型、视觉语言模型等领域的经典论文、教程和Jupyter笔记本系统化整理，帮助用户快速追踪技术演进。其最大亮点在于结构清晰且持续更新，无论是自学还是教学都能直接使用。你可以通过它快速检索前沿文献，用配套笔记本动手实践，或作为面试复习的权威参考。
data_tooling.summary_en: This curated guide serves as a comprehensive resource for anyone diving into generative AI, from research updates to interview prep. It organizes key papers, tutorials, and notebooks across LLMs, vision-language models, and more, making it easy to track the field's rapid evolution. The repository's strength lies in its structured, up-to-date collection, ideal for self-learners or educators building course materials. Use it to quickly find state-of-the-art references, practice with Jupyter notebooks, or prepare for technical interviews.

edge_embedded.name: palmier-pro
edge_embedded.summary: Palmier Pro 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 AI 原生视频编辑器，通过本地运行的 AI 模型（如 Claude 和 Seedance2）实现场景检测、语音转文字、自动剪辑等功能，所有数据在设备端处理，保障隐私安全。技术上采用 Swift 原生开发确保高性能，并支持 MCP 协议扩展 AI 能力。用户可根据转录文本快速生成粗剪，或一键应用 AI 特效，显著提升播客视频、教程录制等后期制作效率。
edge_embedded.summary_en: Palmier Pro is a macOS video editor designed to integrate AI directly into the editing workflow, solving the problem of manual, time-consuming video production. Its core strength lies in leveraging local AI models like Claude and Seedance2 for tasks such as scene detection, transcription, and automated editing, all while keeping data private on-device. You can use it to quickly generate rough cuts from transcripts or apply AI-powered effects, making it ideal for content creators who want to speed up post-production without leaving the desktop.

ui_devex.name: agent-native
ui_devex.summary: Agent-Native 是一个基于 TypeScript 的框架，旨在将 AI 智能体作为应用的一等公民，解决在 React 应用中集成大语言模型时面临的交互结构化与可控性难题。其核心设计理念是将智能体行为抽象为可组合的声明式层，类似 React 组件，开发者可以像搭建 UI 一样定义工具、记忆和推理流程，无需处理底层编排细节。你可以用它快速构建聊天机器人、自主工作流或 AI 副驾驶等原型，并通过自定义 React 组件实现 UI 驱动的智能体控制，让前端开发者也能轻松驾驭 AI 逻辑。
ui_devex.summary_en: Agent-Native is a TypeScript framework for building applications where AI agents are first-class citizens, solving the challenge of integrating LLMs into React apps with structured, controllable interactions. Its key insight is treating agent behavior as a composable, declarative layer—similar to React components—enabling developers to define tools, memory, and reasoning flows without boilerplate. You can use it to quickly prototype AI-powered features like chatbots, autonomous workflows, or copilots, and extend it with custom React components for UI-driven agent control.

deployment_serving.summary_en: This curated guide serves as a comprehensive resource for anyone diving into generative AI, from research updates to interview prep. It organizes key papers, tutorials, and notebooks across LLMs, vision-language models, and more, making it easy to track the field's rapid evolution. The repository's strength lies in its structured, up-to-date collection, ideal for self-learners or educators building course materials. Use it to quickly find state-of-the-art references, practice with Jupyter notebooks, or prepare for technical interviews.

agents_workflows.name: palmier-pro
agents_workflows.summary: Palmier Pro 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 AI 原生视频编辑器，通过本地运行的 AI 模型（如 Claude 和 Seedance2）实现场景检测、语音转文字、自动剪辑等功能，所有数据在设备端处理，保障隐私安全。技术上采用 Swift 原生开发确保高性能，并支持 MCP 协议扩展 AI 能力。用户可根据转录文本快速生成粗剪，或一键应用 AI 特效，显著提升播客视频、教程录制等后期制作效率。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Palmier Pro is a macOS video editor designed to integrate AI directly into the editing workflow, solving the problem of manual, time-consuming video production. Its core strength lies in leveraging local AI models like Claude and Seedance2 for tasks such as scene detection, transcription, and automated editing, all while keeping data private on-device. You can use it to quickly generate rough cuts from transcripts or apply AI-powered effects, making it ideal for content creators who want to speed up post-production without leaving the desktop.

agents_workflows.name: agent-native
agents_workflows.summary: Agent-Native 是一个基于 TypeScript 的框架，旨在将 AI 智能体作为应用的一等公民，解决在 React 应用中集成大语言模型时面临的交互结构化与可控性难题。其核心设计理念是将智能体行为抽象为可组合的声明式层，类似 React 组件，开发者可以像搭建 UI 一样定义工具、记忆和推理流程，无需处理底层编排细节。你可以用它快速构建聊天机器人、自主工作流或 AI 副驾驶等原型，并通过自定义 React 组件实现 UI 驱动的智能体控制，让前端开发者也能轻松驾驭 AI 逻辑。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Agent-Native is a TypeScript framework for building applications where AI agents are first-class citizens, solving the challenge of integrating LLMs into React apps with structured, controllable interactions. Its key insight is treating agent behavior as a composable, declarative layer—similar to React components—enabling developers to define tools, memory, and reasoning flows without boilerplate. You can use it to quickly prototype AI-powered features like chatbots, autonomous workflows, or copilots, and extend it with custom React components for UI-driven agent control.

framework_core.name: agent-native
framework_core.summary: Agent-Native 是一个基于 TypeScript 的框架，旨在将 AI 智能体作为应用的一等公民，解决在 React 应用中集成大语言模型时面临的交互结构化与可控性难题。其核心设计理念是将智能体行为抽象为可组合的声明式层，类似 React 组件，开发者可以像搭建 UI 一样定义工具、记忆和推理流程，无需处理底层编排细节。你可以用它快速构建聊天机器人、自主工作流或 AI 副驾驶等原型，并通过自定义 React 组件实现 UI 驱动的智能体控制，让前端开发者也能轻松驾驭 AI 逻辑。
framework_core.summary_en: Agent-Native is a TypeScript framework for building applications where AI agents are first-class citizens, solving the challenge of integrating LLMs into React apps with structured, controllable interactions. Its key insight is treating agent behavior as a composable, declarative layer—similar to React components—enabling developers to define tools, memory, and reasoning flows without boilerplate. You can use it to quickly prototype AI-powered features like chatbots, autonomous workflows, or copilots, and extend it with custom React components for UI-driven agent control.
